title: Gong bao chicken

ingredients.name: cucumber
ingredients.description: Remove seeds and cut into cubes

methods: In a bowl, mix together the rice wine, egg white, 1/2 tablespoon oil, corn starch and salt. Marinade the chicken in the sauce for 5 minutes.
Heat a wok with the remaining oil, and stir fry the chicken until almost cooked through, then remove to a plate.
Lower the heat and fry the garlic, ginger and dried chilies.
Add the peppers, cucumber and carrot and fry for 3-4 minutes, then add a little water.
Mix together the soy sauce, oyster sauce, chicken stock, a pinch of salt and a pinch of sugar, then add to the wok along with the chicken and fry untilt he chicken is cooked.
Add spring onion and peanuts, a few drops of sesame oil and season with white pepper before serving.
